name: Online Passive Income
goal: Build a low-cost, mostly automated digital product business targeting €1,000/month within five years.

hypotheses.name: ShiftBrief AI
hypotheses.value: Turn shift notes or voice notes into clear handovers and tasks

phases.name: Cloud infrastructure
phases.goal: Private repository, persistent data, cloud execution and cost guardrails

phases.name: Agent brain
phases.goal: Orchestrator, specialist roles, memory, task queue and resume logic

phases.name: Automated research
phases.goal: Search, browser research, evidence capture and source checks

phases.name: Scheduling and reports
phases.goal: Five bounded daily cycles, saved results and notifications

phases.name: Management dashboard
phases.goal: Connect the MVP to persistent project data and show actual agent progress

tasks.title: Build persistent Project Manager and specialist role registry
tasks.acceptance: Orchestrator loads state, selects work, validates, saves progress and creates follow-up tasks.

tasks.title: Map direct competitors and substitutes for café starter kit
tasks.acceptance: At least five relevant products or substitutes with source, price, audience and core promise.
tasks.last_result: Initial sourced competitor scan saved: 6 café template products/substitutes. See data/market_research.json; this is discovery evidence, not proof of sales.

tasks.title: Map direct competitors and substitutes for ShiftBrief AI
tasks.acceptance: At least five relevant products or substitutes with source, price, audience and core promise.
tasks.last_result: Mapped six handover/logbook competitors and substitutes; official pricing pages checked for ShiftForce, Shifo, Venheim and Rotahr. See data/market_research.json and reports/market-research.md.

tasks.title: Compare competitor pricing and business models
tasks.acceptance: Pricing table distinguishes one-time, subscription, free and custom pricing.
tasks.last_result: Compared visible one-time/free/subscription price anchors. Prices differ by currency, tax, venue/team size and scope; some older observations remain flagged for recheck.

tasks.title: Identify recurring customer complaints and unmet needs
tasks.acceptance: Pain-point list backed by reviews or first-hand community discussions.
tasks.last_result: Added first-hand/community discussion evidence for café stock consistency, staffing/owner overload and food waste, plus a hotel shift-handover example where buried notes led to forgotten guest requests. Evidence remains anecdotal and does not establish willingness to pay.
tasks.evidence_limit: Qualitative discovery signals only; no representative sample, validated frequency or willingness-to-pay evidence.

tasks.title: Compare the two hypotheses and choose the cheapest demand test
tasks.acceptance: Evidence-based comparison, risks and a low-cost validation experiment.
tasks.last_result: Compared both hypotheses. Willingness to pay is not demonstrated for either; recommend discovery interviews before choosing or building.

tasks.title: Quality review of market evidence and recommendation
tasks.acceptance: Sources checked, weak evidence labelled, unsupported claims removed.

tasks.title: Prepare first product MVP scope and launch roadmap
tasks.acceptance: Smallest testable MVP, milestones, costs and approval gates.

agent_implementation.description: Technical completion tracker for the agent itself; separate from the passive-income business validation tasks.

components.name: Persistent task orchestration and dependency scheduler
Five specialist role handlers with structured outputs
Result validation, bounded retries, interrupted-run recovery and event log
Unit test suite and CI test gate
Freshness filtering, deduplication and research error handling
Scheduled execution, report generation and dashboard data sync
Dashboard accuracy and agent execution visibility
Atomic persistence for research state and reports

agent_implementation.important_limit: The current agent is deterministic and rules-based. It is not an LLM-powered autonomous researcher. Live browser/search and LLM reasoning require a separately approved integration; no paid API is enabled.
